assertions.check: TAM, SAM, and SOM are each explicitly defined with dollar amounts
TAM calculation cites at least 2 independent data sources
SAM narrows from TAM with explicit filtering criteria (geography, segment, etc.)
SOM includes a realistic capture rate assumption with justification
Bottom-up calculation is included alongside top-down (# customers x ARPU)
Growth rate projections cite industry reports or observable trends
Assumptions are explicitly listed and labeled as assumptions

meta_assertion: Would an analyst trust these numbers enough to include them in an investment memo?
test_prompt: Size the market for a developer deployment automation tool targeting solo developers and small teams.
